visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a grey cap and a black hoodie sits in a folding chair in a vast field of tall, yellow-green grass under a clear blue sky. He speaks directly to the camera with an animated expression, gesturing with his hands. (2) The scene cuts to a large grey elephant with tusks walking slowly across a savanna dotted with low trees and shrubs under an overcast sky. (3) A male lion with a thick brown mane walks forward through short, dry grass, looking toward the lens. (4) The man is back in the field, holding a pair of sunglasses before the camera transitions to him wearing them inside a vehicle and then outside in bright sunlight, smiling. (5) Two female lions are seen resting and moving through lush green bushes. (6) The man holds up a large, white professional telephoto lens attached to a DSLR camera in the field. (7) A digital graphic of a world map appears, highlighted in red and green to show malaria-endemic regions, with text overlays. (8) The man holds a small white bottle with a pink cap labeled 'Picaridin' against the savanna background. (9) A close-up shows hands spraying the liquid repellent onto a forearm covered in black tattoos. (10) The man, now in a black t-shirt, continues to apply the spray to his legs while standing on a wooden deck near a large beige safari tent. (11) Two bottles of the product, one pink and one blue, are shown standing on a stone-paved path. (12) The man stands in front of the tent, talking and holding the bottle, before the camera pans to a stone walkway leading into the distance.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @benwoooo. [Subtitle]: Yo 各位相信肯亞這個國家應該是很多人 bucket list 旅遊清單上面排名前三名的對吧. (2) [Subtitle]: 像是昨日坐在這裏 chill 的時候 大象就在後面走來走去. (3) [Subtitle]: 我這邊就推薦三樣東西 第一個絕對是太陽眼鏡. (4) [Subtitle]: 其實不管是肯亞或是坦尚尼亞 還是會有瘧疾的問題產生. (5) [Slogan]: Malaria Is Still Endemic in 83 Countries. [Logo]: World Health Organization. (6) [Subtitle]: 別蚊我 派卡瑞丁 12H 長效 Picaridin. (7) [Variety]: 勁涼. (8) [Subtitle]: 也別忘了去各大實體通路和官網選購喔.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A vast African savanna with tall grass, scattered shrubs, and trees under a clear or slightly cloudy sky. A luxury safari tent camp with wooden decks and stone paths is also visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator speaks with a high-energy, friendly tone about Kenya, while a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar and light percussion track plays in the background. (2) The narrator's voice remains dominant and clear as he describes safari experiences; the BGM maintains a steady, rhythmic pace. (3) Subtle whoosh sound effects accompany visual transitions between items. (4) The narrator provides technical information about the product with high articulation clarity and moderate vocal arousal. (5) The music continues seamlessly into the closing remarks, ending with a final branded call to action over the rhythmic guitar chords.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem Identification -> Solution Presentation -> Product Demonstration -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional travel vlog intended to endorse 'Picaridin' insect repellent. It uses the allure of a Kenya safari (elephants, lions) to establish a need for protection against sun and malaria, then positions the product as the ultimate essential solution for travelers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal recommendation, and branding overlays.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines lifestyle travel content with a structured product endorsement, utilizing high-quality wildlife footage to maintain engagement.
